transcript.content: Hello, welcome to the clinic. I'm Dr. [Your Name]. Can you tell me what brings you in today?

Um, hi. I guess… work is kind of the main reason. I keep getting up from my station, or like popping up in meetings when I’m supposed to stay put. I don’t mean to be difficult or anything — I just kind of take off before I really think about it. My supervisor said it’s starting to be a safety problem, so… I thought I should come in and talk to someone, if that makes sense.
Do you find yourself acting impulsively in other situations outside of work, like interrupting others or making sudden decisions without thinking them through?

Yeah… I mean, I try not to, but I do cut in on people sometimes. Like if coworkers are talking, I’ll jump in before I really think, or if the lead is asking a question I might answer before they’re even done. I don’t mean it rude or anything, but people get irritated with me. I know I should wait my turn… I’m working on it.

Do you also find yourself acting impulsively in other areas of your life, like at home or during your free time — for example, starting new projects and not finishing them, or making quick decisions about things like spending money or plans?

Um… I don’t know. I mean, maybe sometimes, but I can’t think of anything specific like that right now. At home I’m not trying to be irresponsible or anything. I guess I’d have to think about it more? Like, I don’t want to say yes if I’m not totally sure.
Do you find it hard to focus or finish tasks at home, like chores or projects, even when you intend to?

Um… yeah, sometimes. I mean, I can usually start something, but keeping my attention on it is hard. Like at work, when I’m doing inventory logs or reading the CNC training pages, I really am trying, but after a few minutes the numbers or words kind of run together. Then I realize I didn’t really take it in and I have to go back over it again. I don’t know if that’s the kind of thing you mean.
Looking back on your childhood, do you remember having similar issues with staying focused or acting before thinking, like in school or when doing homework?

Yeah… I think so. I mean, I don’t want to make it sound like I was just a bad kid or anything, but even in elementary school I remember getting in trouble for not staying in my seat. I’d talk over the teacher or blurt stuff out before I was supposed to.

My mom would get notes sent home sometimes because I was wandering around the room or interrupting. I wasn’t trying to be disrespectful… it was just like I’d do it before I really thought about it. Is that the kind of thing you mean?
Do you often feel restless or have a hard time staying still, like you're always 'on the go' or feel internally driven to move around?

Yeah… I think so. I mean, I don’t want to make it sound dramatic, but when I have to stand still by the machine, or sit through training, I get this feeling like pressure building up in my body. Like I need to move or stretch or pace, or just go do something right then.

I can usually try to hold it in, but it’s really uncomfortable. Is that what you mean by restless?
